## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused change and regression tests where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, project state, model weights or private data committed
- [ ] Security/permission/network impact explained
- [ ] No unrestricted fallback, integrity raising, automatic paid calls or automatic merge
- [ ] Mocked/discovered/skipped checks not presented as real acceptance
- [ ] User-facing docs updated; third-party notices retained
